summary: Frontend-only testing (LIVE prod, hostbay@moxx.co) of 3 features + mobile: (1) DRAG reorder of Quick Actions Customize, (2) Empty Volume Hero via route interception, (3) Font consistency on /invoices and /pay-links/products. Reorder + persistence + add/remove counter + reset-to-default: ALL PASS. Empty hero renders correctly with headline 'Make your first sale' and both CTAs navigate correctly (/create-pay-link and /creator). Mobile 390x844 responsive checks all pass (2x2 QA grid, stacked empty-hero CTAs, no horizontal overflow, tappable dialog). Normal hero shown for real active account (empty state correctly hidden). Font issue: /invoices main invoice-list TABLE numeric cells (Total, VAT) still render in Inter, NOT monospace — Roboto Mono is only applied to the Tax Report summary cards, not the invoice-list table. Products price renders in GeistMono (mono OK but not literal Roboto Mono as spec says). Body font is GeistSans app-wide (same as previous iteration). Account left on DEFAULT [paylinks, invoice, wallet, creator].

issues: Numeric cells in the invoice-list table (Total column, VAT column) render in __Inter (sans), NOT in Roboto Mono. Spec says numeric values should use Roboto Mono / tabular font. Tax Report tab summary cards DO use Roboto Mono correctly ($12.67, $7.30, $5.37, etc.), but the primary invoice-list numerics (e.g., '$1.87', '$1.56') do not. Header 'Total' column values are not wrapped in the var(--font-mono) span.

Product price ('5.00 USD') renders monospace but uses __GeistMono, not __Roboto_Mono. Visually monospace/tabular ✓, but spec explicitly says 'Roboto Mono'. Prior iteration flagged similar Geist-vs-Inter ambiguity; likely same root cause: var(--font-mono) resolves to Geist Mono globally instead of Roboto Mono for products (while /invoices Tax Report DOES resolve to Roboto Mono, showing the font is registered).

Body computed fontFamily is __GeistSans, not __Inter. Same as previous iteration 43 finding — consistency with dashboard/wallet/transactions preserved, but if spec strictly requires Inter, the outer Box's `--font-sans: var(--font-inter)` scoping does not appear to override the global Geist Sans on the body element (getComputedStyle(document.body).fontFamily returns Geist Sans on both pages).

action_items: Wrap invoice-list table numeric cells (Total, VAT columns) in the var(--font-mono) tabular span on /invoices — currently only the Tax Report summary cards use Roboto Mono; the primary invoice-list table (rendered on the default Invoices tab) still shows numerics in Inter.

If spec literally requires Roboto Mono (not Geist Mono) on /pay-links/products product price, adjust the CSS var scoping so var(--font-mono) resolves to Roboto Mono on that page too (works on /invoices Tax Report but not on products list).

If spec literally requires Inter body font, the outer Box `--font-sans` override on both pages doesn't propagate to document.body — check whether the scope needs to apply to a higher ancestor or use `font-family: var(--font-inter)` directly on the Box's sx.
Note: functional correctness of empty hero + reorder + persistence + mobile is fully verified — the above are cosmetic/spec-literal issues only.
critical_code_review_comments: VolumeHero empty branch is correctly wired (data-testid=dash2026-hero-empty, CTAs use router.push to /create-pay-link and /creator, framer-motion stack on mobile with flexDirection xs=column). No issues found.

QuickActionsDock Reorder.Group + drag persists ordered array via PUT /api/user/dashboard-quick-actions; verified by reload showing tiles in new order. Save-disabled when count!=4, Save-enabled at 4/4. Add/Remove sections behave correctly. Reset-to-default works.

Invoices Tax-Report cards correctly use Roboto Mono — proves the font var is registered. Missing coverage on the invoice-list table cells is likely a one-line span wrap fix on the numeric TD renderers.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all functional flows PASS; 3 cosmetic font-scoping spec deviations remain)

seed_data_creation: None. Only benign writes were 2 updates to hostbay's dashboard_quick_actions preference (custom then default). Final state restored to DEFAULT [paylinks, invoice, wallet, creator].
context_for_next_testing_agent: All primary flows verified: (a) Drag reorder actually changes DOM order of dash2026-qa-pinned-* rows AND persists — reload of /dashboard shows tile order = pinned order (proved by moving 'paylinks' from #1 to #4: tiles reloaded as [invoice, wallet, creator, paylinks]). (b) Add/Remove correctly toggles counter 3/4↔4/4 and enables/disables Save; catalog shows 7 unselected ids when 3 pinned. (c) Reset-to-default restores [paylinks, invoice, wallet, creator]. (d) Empty hero renders via route.route('**/api/dashboard**') interception zeroing data.total_transactions.count, data.total_volume.amount, amount_formatted='$0.00', today_summary.transactions_today; both CTAs (dash2026-hero-empty-cta -> /create-pay-link and -cta2 -> /creator) navigate correctly (use force=True + expect_navigation because MUI CustomButton uses onClick router.push, not href). (e) Normal hero shown for real hostbay account (has sales). (f) Mobile 390x844: no horizontal overflow on dashboard/invoices/products; QA is 2x2 grid; empty-hero CTAs stack vertically; Customize dialog usable and tap-remove works. (g) 0 console errors across all navigations. Remaining known gaps: /invoices main list table Total/VAT numerics still Inter (only Tax Report cards are Roboto Mono); /pay-links/products price uses Geist Mono not Roboto Mono; body font resolves to Geist Sans app-wide.
